description: Florina station is the terminus, a stone-and-brick building with a pitched tile roof beside a side platform where the tracks end. The morning is clear, about 12.4°C. The Sakoulevas river is not in the frame. Sources disagree on how much of the 1931 building survived 1944, so the image follows the documented pitched-roof station and does not claim a measured facade.
